attributes.name: page_length
attributes.definition: Overall length of the page and how much content (sections, repeated content, word count) it contains.

values.definition: Short page with few sections or bands, little repeated content and a low word count.
Moderate length with a typical number of sections.
Very long scroll with many sections or repeated feed-like content.

attributes.name: vertical_spacing_density
attributes.definition: How tight or loose the vertical spacing between sections and elements is.

values.definition: Tighter vertical spacing and no empty placeholder slots.

attributes.name: form_and_control_quantity
attributes.definition: How many forms and interactive input controls the page has.

values.definition: A single form with one input, or very few controls.

attributes.name: technical_weight
attributes.definition: Page weight and markup leanness: number of images, scripts, metadata and classes.

values.definition: Minimal images, few scripts, minimal metadata and lean markup with few classes.
Average amount of assets, scripts and markup.
Many images, scripts, rich metadata and heavily classed markup.
